source: Rovamo, J. & Virsu, V. (1979). An estimation and application of the human cortical magnification factor. Experimental Brain Research, 37, 495-510.
figure: Figure 3 — Relative contrast sensitivity as function of eccentricity at different spatial frequencies
notes: Values normalized to foveal sensitivity (=1.0) at each spatial frequency. Digitized from published figure, averaged across meridians. The M-scaling prediction: sensitivity(ecc) = 1 / (1 + ecc/E2) where E2 depends on spatial frequency.
